SCAQMD comment letter (seven areas of concern; notes unmitigated risk exceeds threshold; recommends a truck cap at analyzed levels)
Nighttime noise (53.6 dBA modeled vs. 55.0 dBA ambient at the east receptor; no noise mitigation proposed)
Southern truck driveway LOS E/F (acknowledged as unavoidable; delay worsens in every future-year scenario)
